title: Protected-skill guard condition deviates from spec code snippet
description: Spec Step 2 shows an unconditional guard (`if PROTECTED_SKILLS.contains(&name.as_str()) { return Err() }`), but the implementation uses a conditional check that also verifies local_path.exists(). The conditional approach was required to prevent the kernel itself from failing when loading protected skills internally. The spec raw requirement ('when the kernel discovers a file') supports the conditional approach, but the discrepancy between code snippet and description creates ambiguity for future implementors.
proposed_resolution: Clarify spec Step 2 to show the conditional guard pattern explicitly, or introduce a separate kernel-internal skill loader that bypasses the project-override guard, making load_skill the project-facing loader only.
